dimension.$description: Raw px scale — union of D-003 (space: 0/8/16/24/32/40/48/64/80/96/128/160) and D-004 (size: icon 16/20/24/32, avatar 24/32/40/48/64/96, control 40/48/56/64). Keyed by literal px value so both space.* and size.* semantic groups can alias the same primitive without namespace collision. This file has NO meaning by itself — semantic/component layers decide whether a given number means 'space' or 'size'.
